'''Anjeru Valett''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as an attorney following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] establishment. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], he attended the launch of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]'' on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
